integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: Connect your ERP, HR or biometric system with API keys and signed webhooks.
integrations.forbidden: Only owners and admins can manage integrations.

keys.empty_body: Create a key for each system that talks to KaamSathi. Give it only the scopes it needs.
keys.revoke_body: Systems using “{name}” stop working immediately. This cannot be undone.
keys.new_desc: Name the system and pick what it may do.
keys.name: Name
keys.shown_once: This is the only time the full key is shown. Store it in your system's secret store now.

webhooks.empty_body: We POST signed JSON to your URL when things happen — a worker joins, payroll is approved, a timesheet is approved.
webhooks.url_hint: Must be https and reachable from the internet.
webhooks.events_hint: Leave all unticked to receive every event.
webhooks.delete_body: Its delivery log is deleted too.
webhooks.rotate_body: The old secret stops working immediately. Update your receiver right after.
webhooks.secret_warning: Shown only now. Use it to verify X-KaamSathi-Signature on every request.
webhooks.deliveries_desc: Every attempt to {url}. Failed deliveries are retried after 1 min, 5 min, 30 min, 2 h and 12 h.

developers.title: KaamSathi enterprise API
developers.intro: Read and write your organisation's jobs, workforce, hajiri, payroll and timesheets from your own systems, and receive signed webhooks when things change.
developers.rule_keys: Organisation API keys, shown once and stored only as a hash.
developers.rule_scope: Each key sees one organisation and only the scopes you grant it.
developers.rule_signed: Every webhook is HMAC-signed and retried with backoff.
developers.start_1: An owner or admin opens Integrations in KaamSathi and creates an API key with only the scopes the system needs.
developers.start_2: Store the key in your system's secret store — it is shown once.
developers.start_3: Add a webhook endpoint, copy its signing secret and send a test event.
developers.webhooks_1: Subscribe an https endpoint to the events you need (or all of them).
developers.verify_1: Compare in constant time and reject timestamps older than five minutes.
developers.footer_note: Payroll and hajiri data are personal data of your workers. Keep keys secret, give each system its own key, and revoke keys you no longer use. Questions: support@kaamsathi.com.np.
